note: Round 148: the Road Workshop (a portable bench, in four stages) and the sects' techniques. Long chains; each step is a thing to do or hand in. Nothing is for sale.

lines.name: The Folding Table
lines.text: A bench you can carry. Hale says a good one folds flat, holds an anvil's weight and costs an honest pile of materials. Gather them and learn the joinery.

steps.text: Bring Hale the stock for a frame: iron, hide for the hinges.
Make six things at any bench, to learn the weight of the work.
Seasoned wood and resin for the top.
Make eight more, harder ones (difficulty 6 or more).
Reach Smithing 3: the hinges have to be forged true.

reward.text: You can set up a folding table anywhere. Crafting on the road no longer costs you the no-bench penalty.

lines.name: The Field Forge
lines.text: A forge that fits in a pack: a firebox, a bellows of oiled hide, a pair of tongs that never leave your belt.

steps.text: Slag and firestone for the firebox.
Forge six things of some difficulty (10 or more).
Reach Smithing 8.
Bellows leather and fine wire.
Reach floor 7, where the furnace-kings keep their coal.
Make ten things of difficulty 20 or more, to prove the forge.

reward.text: Your folding table now carries a field forge: smithing at it counts as working at a real forge, anywhere.

lines.name: The Alchemist's Roll
lines.text: A roll of pouches, scales and lacquered paper. Pills, tonics and rune marks at a camp fire, if you can carry the reagents without ruining them.

steps.text: Silk and paper for the roll itself.
Reach Alchemy 8.
Brew eight things of difficulty 25 or more.
Mirror-silver and glass for the scales.
Reach floor 13.
Make twelve things of difficulty 40 or more.

reward.text: The rune table and the alchemist's bench both travel with you now.

lines.name: The Master's Kit
lines.text: Everything a master carries: a true anvil block, a ring of dies, a lens, a lamp. The materials are rare, the work is exact, and no one will hand you the last piece.

steps.text: Star-iron and gantry steel for the anvil block.
Reach Smithing 14.
Make ten things of difficulty 50 or more.
Rare crystal for the lens and lamp.
Reach floor 19.
Fell 60 foes from floor 12 down, with the kit on your back.
Make twelve things of difficulty 70 or more.

reward.text: The Master's Kit: sturdier work and finer finish, anywhere you set it down.

lines.name: The Reliable Seed
lines.text: The Lotus Ascent Academy teaches a way of building the inner world that does not wither when you look away. The Elders ask a great deal before they teach it.

steps.text: Become an Inner Disciple of the Lotus Ascent Academy.
Open your inner world to level 3: a valley.
Offerings for the Elder: resin, heartwood, a living heart.
Fell 40 foes from floor 6 down, and keep the beasts you meet.
Sit 90 minutes in all, so the Elder can see how you hold still.
Become a Core Disciple.
A sample of the deep stuff.
Grow the inner world to level 4: a small heaven.

reward.text: The Reliable Seed: the inner world grows half again as fast, holds two more beasts, gains a plot, and its workshop room opens (it adds to your crafting wherever you are).

lines.name: The Steady Hands Method
lines.text: The Blacksmiths' Guild keeps a method that makes failure rare. It is only taught to those who have failed often enough to understand it.

steps.text: Become a Journeyman Smith.
Forge eight things of difficulty 30 or more for the guild's examiners.
A guild fee, paid in steel.
Reach Smithing 14.
Become a Master Smith.
Forge six things of difficulty 60 or more.

reward.text: The Steady Hands Method: crafting succeeds noticeably more often.

lines.name: The Wayfinder's Step
lines.text: The Adventurers' Lodge trains its champions in a way of walking that wastes nothing. They want proof you have walked far.

steps.text: Become a Vanguard of the Lodge.
Reach floor 12.
Fell 80 foes from floor 10 down.
Storm-glass and thunder-iron for the old compass.
Reach floor 16.
Become a Pathfinder.

reward.text: The Wayfinder's Step: you move a little faster and sense a little further.

lines.name: The Hearth-Fire Breath
lines.text: The Alchemists' Circle burns a small fire at the centre of the body. The breath that tends it is taught only to those who can brew what it burns.

steps.text: Become a Refiner of the Circle.
Brew ten things of difficulty 45 or more.
Lotus, lichen and ember for the first coal.
Reach Alchemy 14.
Become a Pill Master.

reward.text: The Hearth-Fire Breath: qi comes more easily and a little life returns as you go.

lines.name: The Gatherer's Eye
lines.text: The Gatherers' Hall can read a hillside. They teach it to those who have walked a thousand hillsides.

steps.text: Become a Picker.
Rare herbs for the Hall's pressed book.
Fell 50 foes from floor 8 down, gathering as you go.
Become a Prospector.
Reach floor 14.

reward.text: The Gatherer's Eye: more finds from every plant and vein.

lines.name: The World-Seed
lines.text: There is a technique older than the sects: the world-seed, from which a hidden world is raised in one lifetime. The Lotus Elders know a page of it. The Masters know another. Each asks for the rarest things.

steps.text: Become a True Disciple.
Grow the inner world to level 5: a living realm.
Dragon, drake and the dust of immortals.
Fell 150 foes from floor 16 down.
Sit 300 minutes in all.
A mirror that does not lie, and a seal that cannot be forged.
Reach floor 25.
Grow the inner world to level 6: a hidden world.
Become the Elder's Chosen.

reward.text: The World-Seed: the inner world's gifts are half again stronger, its levels run to the top, and your insight comes a little easier.
